metadata.name: errorcatalogue
metadata.description: Catalogue of standardized error codes and messages for the ANQR product

errors.title: Invalid Request
errors.description: The request payload is malformed or missing required fields.

errors.title: Invalid Parameter
errors.description: One or more query parameters are invalid or out of range.

errors.title: Unauthorized
errors.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.

errors.title: Forbidden
errors.description: The user lacks permission to perform the requested operation.

errors.title: Resource Not Found
errors.description: The requested resource does not exist.

errors.title: Internal Server Error
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
